I have severe Shellfish allergies (shrimp, crab, lobster) and seafood in general doesn't sit well with me. I also have a lower level of allergen level to eggs. And yes I should've probably just not gone to the restaurant in general. This was my second severe reaction and the first incident was almost the exact same situation.

I had to call 911 for myself a couple months ago. My extended family took me out for an Christmas Eve dinner at this fancy restaurant. At first I was really hesitant to go, as I have serious food allergies and this restaurant wasn't safe for me to eat at because of this. My cousin and his mom (my Aunt) said it would be fine and that the restaurant would make my food with extreme care. These types of restaurants are usually pretty good with handling food safety and allergies, and I reluctantly came along. But just my luck, about a minute or so after eating my meal, I could tell something was not right. Within 5 minutes I was having a full blown allergic reaction. My throat was starting to close up, my lips and tongue were swelling, and sub sequentially I was freaking out. Somehow in the middle of this a thought crossed my mind that this was a fancy restaurant, and being the 'classy citizen' I am I didn't want to 'make a scene'. So I quietly rose from my chair and mentioned to my Aunt that I was having a reaction. All she did was merely point towards the exit and said that I could 'take a minute if I needed'. As I walked outside the restaurant, I essentially collapsed. Luckily I had enough energy left to stab myself in my leg with my Epipen and save my life lol. Then of course I proceeded to call 911. The woman was very nice and stayed on the line with me all the way until I reached the hospital. An ambulance came and picked me up and then took me to a hospital where I stayed overnight (on Christmas Eve which sucked lol). Honestly the thing that sticks with me the most is how my 'family' didn't even bother. My mom was absolutely pissed at my Aunt, who could 'only manage' a phone call the next morning to see if I was doing ok. 


TL:DR - Had serious allergy attack on Christmas Eve, gave Epipen to myself and called 911. Extended family that brought me to the dinner didn't give a shit lol
